cycle-accurate-hw.desc: Use when adding or modifying cycle-accurate hardware simulation (CPU/systolic/memory), energy models, and profiler integration in src/hardware.
cycle-accurate-hw.overview: Implements the workflow for cycle-level simulation updates and consistency checks.

compression-pruning.desc: Use when implementing pruning, sparsity metrics, and sparse speedup analysis.
compression-pruning.overview: Guides compression research changes and pruning-related validation.

nas.desc: Use when modifying neural architecture search search-space and search algorithms under hardware constraints.
nas.overview: Covers random/evolutionary/surrogate NAS updates and evaluation hooks.

distillation.desc: Use when adding teacher-student distillation workflows and KL-based supervision.
distillation.overview: Maintains distillation utilities and test coverage.

advanced-layers.desc: Use when implementing advanced layers including pooling, embedding, attention, and transformer blocks.
advanced-layers.overview: Defines layer design patterns and backward-pass expectations for advanced architectures.

losses-extra.desc: Use when adding or tuning advanced losses (focal/huber/kldiv) and their exports/tests.
losses-extra.overview: Ensures loss additions are exported and numerically stable in tests.

optimizers-extra.desc: Use when adding advanced optimizers (AdamW/Nadam/AdaBound) and integration tests.
optimizers-extra.overview: Standardizes optimizer API and state update semantics.

data-extra.desc: Use when extending datasets, augmentation transforms, and sampling utilities.
data-extra.overview: Maintains offline dataset fallbacks and augmentation pipelines.

benchmark.desc: Use when adding hardware benchmarking and Pareto visualization workflows.
benchmark.overview: Keeps benchmark helpers and plotting tools aligned for architecture comparison.

integration.desc: Use when wiring all feature modules together, updating README, and creating end-to-end demos.
integration.overview: Integration checklist for exports, docs, requirements, and final smoke runs.

hardware-research-metrics.desc: Use when implementing deep hardware objective metrics, roofline efficiency, EDP, and constraint-violation analysis.
hardware-research-metrics.overview: Adds quantitative research metric primitives for hardware-aware optimization.

optimization-study.desc: Use when building ablation/ranking studies across hardware-model candidates with objective metrics.
optimization-study.overview: Provides end-to-end study runners and ranking logic for optimization experiments.
